keyPoints: Rinatmak ghatank ka matlab vyutkram: a^(-m) = 1/a^m — 2^(-3) = 1/8, aur 10^(-2) = 1/100 = 0.01 — ghatank jitna bada rinatmak, maan utna chhota.
Ghatank ke niyam rinatmak ghatankon par bhi lagte hain: a^m x a^(-m) = a^0 = 1 — niyam badalte nahi.
(a/b)^(-m) = (b/a)^m — bhinn palatne par ghatank ka chihn badal jaata hai, jaise (2/3)^(-2) = (3/2)^2 = 9/4.
10 ke rinatmak ghatank se chhoti sankhyaen likho: 0.0001 = 10^(-4) — bindu ke baad jitne shunya-sthan, utna rinatmak ghatank.
Manak roop me 1 se 10 ke beech sankhya x 10 ki ghat — 0.0000005 = 5 x 10^(-7); vigyan me bahut chhoti naap isi me likhi jaati hai.
Tulna ke liye ghatankon ko same aadhar me badlo: 2^(-3) aur 4^(-1) me 4^(-1) = 2^(-2), to 2^(-2) bada hai.
Aam galti: a^(-m) ko -a^m samajhna — rinatmak ghatank vyutkram deta hai (1/a^m), rinatmak sankhya nahi.
